post.description:
Private shop attachment, max 5 MiB, PDF/PNG/JPEG (attachment:manage).

Ownership comes from session context. Files are stored privately in the DB,
never under a public directory. Contact identity links require contact_uuid,
contact:manage and settings:update; links cannot be reassigned or deleted.

get.description: Revalidate membership and shop before downloading (attachment:read).
Read append-only tenant audit history (audit:read).

post.description: Create a customer/agent (contact:manage); identity needs settings:update.

Read a contact, with identity redacted for ordinary staff (contact:read).

get.description: Gross receivables/payables per role and currency, derived from sealed ledger lines.
Inclusive Kabul dates and paged movements; CSV requires report:read and exports all rows.
Read expense categories (report:read).

post.description: Create a category, including salaries (settings:update).

patch.description: Rename or deactivate a retained category (settings:update).

post.description: Post a expense atomically; identical retries replay the original response.

Read expected, counted, difference and approval details (report:read).
Export the immutable numeric cash snapshot as CSV (report:read).

post.description: Owner-approved opening against equity, once per box/currency; identical retries replay.
Owner correction through a linked reversal, subject to available cash.

get.description: Read posted journals (report:read), optionally filtered by currency and Kabul day.
Read cashbox journals including openings/reversals (cashbox:read).

post.description: Append buying/selling quote-per-base rates (settings:update).

get.description: Read rate history with inclusive Kabul dates (exchange:read).

post.description: Calculate exact nonbinding amounts, rounding and costs (exchange:create).
Post a cash or credit exchange; identical Idempotency-Key retries replay.

get.description: Search shop exchanges by date, reference, cashier, customer or currency.
Read original transaction details and reversal status (exchange:read).
Retrieve the unchanged receipt snapshot without posting (exchange:read).

post.description: Owner-approved linked reversal with reason (exchange:reverse); cash rules apply.
Record received/paid cash and allocations atomically (payment:create).

get.description: Search shop payment history (payment:read); dates are inclusive Kabul days.
Read original payment and current reversal status (payment:read).
Return the immutable original payment receipt, without posting (payment:read).

post.description: Owner-approved linked reversal restores allocations and cash (payment:reverse).

get.description: Return original, paid, remaining amounts and settlement history (contact:read).

post.description: Create an unfunded draft with a unique reference (hawala:create).

get.description: Search shop transfer history (hawala:read); inclusive Kabul creation dates.

Retain current owner's paid/cancelled dispute review; no financial reversal implied.
Allocate cash or manually completed external settlement (agent_settlement:create).

get.description: List settlement evidence/history (contact:read), with inclusive Kabul dates.

GetUserResponse.description: Response schema for retrieving a single user's profile.

HawalaTermsData.title: HawalaTermsData
HawalaTermsData.description: Validated input terms frozen with canonical values at confirmation.

HawalaUpdateRequest.title: HawalaUpdateRequest
HawalaUpdateRequest.description: Only supplied fields change; direction is fixed when the draft is created.

LoginData.title: LoginData
LoginData.description:
Authentication data returned after login.

If 2FA is enabled, returns a temporary challenge token
instead of normal access and refresh tokens.

LoginRequest.title: LoginRequest
LoginRequest.description:
Schema for validating user authentication credentials.

Accepts an email address together with the user's password.

LoginResponse.title: LoginResponse
LoginResponse.description:
Schema for the successful login response.
Contains authentication tokens and user session details.

LogoutResponse.title: LogoutResponse
LogoutResponse.description: Response schema for successful user logout.

OTPSetupData.title: OTPSetupData
OTPSetupData.description: Data required to set up OTP authentication.

OTPSetupResponse.title: OTPSetupResponse
OTPSetupResponse.description: Response containing the OTP setup details.

PasswordResetResponse.title: PasswordResetResponse
PasswordResetResponse.description:
Response schema for successful password management operations
(e.g., reset request or password update).

RecoveryCodesData.title: RecoveryCodesData
RecoveryCodesData.description: Data containing the user's two-factor authentication recovery codes.

RefreshData.title: RefreshData
RefreshData.description: Authentication data returned after refreshing an access token.

RefreshResponse.title: RefreshResponse
RefreshResponse.description: Response schema for successful access-token refresh.

RegisterRequest.title: RegisterRequest
RegisterRequest.description:
Schema for the user registration request.

Extends CreateUserRequest by adding a requirement to accept
the terms and conditions.

RegisterResponse.title: RegisterResponse
RegisterResponse.description:
Schema for the successful registration response.
Returns the created user's basic data.

ResendVerificationEmailRequest.title: ResendVerificationEmailRequest
ResendVerificationEmailRequest.description: Schema for requesting a new email verification link.

ResendVerificationEmailResponse.title: ResendVerificationEmailResponse
ResendVerificationEmailResponse.description: Response schema for successfully requesting a new verification email.

ResetPasswordRequest.title: ResetPasswordRequest
ResetPasswordRequest.description: Schema for resetting a password using a valid reset token.

RevokeSessionResponse.title: RevokeSessionResponse
RevokeSessionResponse.description: Response schema for successful session revocation.

SessionsResponse.title: SessionsResponse
SessionsResponse.description: Response schema for listing all active user sessions.

TOTPSetupData.title: TOTPSetupData
TOTPSetupData.description: Data required to set up TOTP authentication.

TOTPSetupResponse.title: TOTPSetupResponse
TOTPSetupResponse.description: Response containing the TOTP setup details.

TOTPVerifyRequest.title: TOTPVerifyRequest
TOTPVerifyRequest.description: Schema for verifying a TOTP code.

UpdateEmailRequest.title: UpdateEmailRequest
UpdateEmailRequest.description: Schema for updating the user's email address.

UpdateUserRequest.title: UpdateUserRequest
UpdateUserRequest.description:
Schema for validating user profile update data.

Allows updating personal information, username, email, and birthday.
All fields are optional to support PATCH requests.

UpdateUsernameRequest.title: UpdateUsernameRequest
UpdateUsernameRequest.description: Schema for updating the user's username.

UserData.title: UserData
UserData.description:
Data transfer object for User information.

Represents the core user attributes used in responses and internal
data handling.

VerifyEmailRequest.title: VerifyEmailRequest
VerifyEmailRequest.description: Schema for verifying a user's email address using a token.
